name: LoveSick
source:
Aimi has had nothing but bad luck when it comes to love. When a cute boy saves her one day, she swears that this time she'll find love...

But he has a girlfriend...

Will Aimi move on? Be happy being friends? Eliminate the competition?

Or will she..........?

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/lovesick]itch.io[/url]]
